notes.title: Eyebrows and orchestral score! (Patch 1.3)
notes.notes:
We have filled this update with fixes, balancing, and new features! Oh, you want to hear more? Here are a couple of highlights:

- The music in the chapter “Baby Steps” has been recorded by our good friends at FAME’s Skopje Studio Orchestra - and it sounds great!
- Do you know the feeling of wishing you could just forget something to experience it again from a fresh start? While we can’t delete your memories we can at least give you the option to delete your save game.
- Try pressing the triggers on your controllers while looking in the mirror - we might have added something important.
- We have rescued the elephant who was drowning in a level on the Island. Sorry, elefriend!
- “Nailed It” has been adjusted to be a bit less mysterious.
- The autopilot in “Boeing A4” has gone back to pilot school and is now much more able to help you out.

The full list of changes is really long and we are thrilled with all the changes that we got to put in. We are also really happy that you (yes YOU) are playing. Have fun and keep an eye out for the next update!

notes.title: 1.2.0 Update - Bug fixes, balancing and second screen smoothing!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year from everybody here at Triband!

We have added smoothing to the camera being shown on your monitor. This doesn't change anything in the headset, but people watching you play will hopefully appreciate less dizzying movement.

This update brings several bug fixes. Here are some notable mentions:

 Fixed issue where some players got stuck after completing a level.
 Fixed issue where text in the game did not load correctly if the system language was not one of the supported languages. To those afflicted, undskyld, anteeksi, Því miður, padon, etc.


We have noticed that some levels are a bit trickier than we would like - so we tried to improve them!

 It is now easier to hit targets in "Baby Steps/Baby Food".
 The volleyball in "Island/Jaws" should be easier to hit.
 Game play elements in "Batville/Pinball", "Batville/The Big Lebatski" and "Fixing the Home/Pipe Dreams" are closer to the you, and should not require you to reach outside the guardian.


We have also added an exit button to the credits scene and hidden a secret that was previously visible before the game was completed.

We hope you enjoy the game, and please don't hesitate to reach out if you experience any issues while playing WHAT THE BAT?.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 (Various small fixes and balancing)
notes.notes:
We are so happy to see all of you playing WHAT THE BAT?!

We have compiled a bunch of fixes and changes to balancing in this patch. The most notable are listed here:
- The textures in Blockhead don't move around anymore.
- The blue planet in Interplanetary can be moved again.
- Baseball spawning in the boss fight has been fixed, making the fight a bit easier!
- Many other small tweaks and fixes.

Keep on batting!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 (Harvest Fix)
notes.notes: This update should fix the blocker in the Harvest level that some players have experienced.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 (HTC Vive and Valve Index Support)
notes.notes:
We are very happy to say that we now support HTC Vive and Valve Index. Thank you for playing - keep on batting!

- Fixed remapping of progression stars on baskets.
- Lifted alien duck projectiles in pinball level.
- Secondary buttons can open the mind menu.
- Added support for HTC Vive and Valve Index
